sections.kicker: Made for the way you work
sections.title: A deliberate boundary between work and storage.
sections.lede: Stage, select, edit and commit at your own pace.

items.title: Stage in RAM
items.body: Drop files into a volatile staging layer and inspect their state.

items.title: Work on a selection
items.body: Select a group with checkboxes or keyboard shortcuts. Open staged files in their associated editor.

items.title: Commit with intent
items.body: Commit or discard the selected files. If a destination changed, conflict recovery preserves both versions.
